8.3.4.1.2 Dem_GetDTCStatusAvailabilityMask
[SWS_Dem_00213]
Definition of API function Dem_GetDTCStatusAvailability
Mask
Upstream requirements: RS_Diag_04067
⌈
Service Name
Dem_GetDTCStatusAvailabilityMask
Syntax
Std_ReturnType Dem_GetDTCStatusAvailabilityMask (
uint8 ClientId,
Dem_UdsStatusByteType* DTCStatusMask,
Dem_DTCOriginType DTCOrigin
)
Service ID [hex]
0x16
Sync/Async
Synchronous
Reentrancy
Non Reentrant Re-entrant for different ClientIDs, Non re-entrant for same ClientId.
ClientId
Unique client id, assigned to the instance of the calling module.
Parameters (in)
DTCOrigin
This parameter selects the event memory the DTCStatus
AvailabilityMask is requested for. Only the values DEM_DTC_
ORIGIN_PRIMARY_ MEMORY and DEM_DTC_ORIGIN_
USERDEFINED_MEMORY_<Name> are valid.
Parameters (inout)
None
Parameters (out)
DTCStatusMask
DTCStatusMask The value DTCStatusMask indicates the
supported DTC status bits from the Dem. All supported
information is indicated by setting the corresponding status bit to
1. See ISO14229-1.
Return value
Std_ReturnType
E_OK: get of DTC status mask was successful
E_NOT_OK: get of DTC status mask failed
Description
Gets the DTC Status availability mask of the selected fault memory.
Available via
Dem.h
⌋
